items.title: Kering affonda a Parigi: calo vendite Gucci
items.summary: Kering fell as much as 12.3% in Paris after Q3. Gucci revenue was EUR 1.291bn, down 6% comparable, with direct stores down 9% and wholesale up 45%; APAC down 14%. Jewelry grew 18%. Management points to higher average ticket and more Q4 launches.

items.title: Gucci: les ventes chutent encore de 6%, Kering prevoit au moins 125 fermetures
items.summary: French market site: Gucci Q3 down 6% on weak China traffic, DOS down 9%; 105 net closures done in nine months, 2026 target raised to at least 125; CFO declined to give revenue guidance for the rest of the year.

items.title: Kering turnaround hopes hit by drop in Gucci sales
items.summary: Reuters: Gucci Q3 down 6% constant currency to EUR 1.29bn on weak footfall, mainly China. De Meo's five-year margin plan faces headwinds (weak China, US slowdown, Iran war); an analyst says efficiency measures alone will not revive brands that lost pull.

items.title: Gucci Owner Kering Testing Patience of Shoppers and Shareholders
items.summary: Opinion column (paywalled, not fetched; framing taken from headline and search summary): argues Demna has yet to set out a compelling vision and that Kering is stretching patience of both shoppers and investors. Critical.

items.title: Kering reports flat third-quarter revenue; stock nears EUR 178.12 low
items.summary: German wire on Oct 29: Kering trades near EUR 178.73, close to its 250-session low, after Gucci comparable revenue fell 6%; 105 net store closures year to date.

items.title: Kering-Aktie: Gucci enttaeuscht erneut
items.summary: German financial wire: Kering shares dropped about 11% to a yearly low after Gucci's comparable decline deepened to 6% from 2% the prior quarter.

items.title: Kering holds steady, but Gucci remains a cause for concern
items.summary: Group Q3 revenue flat at EUR 3.35bn, LFL -1%, nine months -2%; Gucci framed as the persistent drag while Saint Laurent and Bottega Veneta outperform; retail network cuts continue.

items.title: Kering's Gucci Turnaround Looks Further Away, Berenberg Says
items.summary: Berenberg cut 2026-28 forecasts and its sell-rated target to EUR 165 from 175, seeing little evidence of a Gucci rebound into Q4. Page undated; date inferred from Q3 context.

items.title: Kering Q3 revenue flat as Gucci slips 4pc
items.summary: Trade recap of Q3: Gucci revenue EUR 1.291bn, -4% reported (-6% comparable); group flat. Page not fetched (403); figures taken from search snippet and cross-checked with Forbes Italia.

items.title: Demna Brings GucciCore to the Streets of New York
items.summary: Activation coverage: GucciCore campaign photographed by Peter Funch, New Yorkers styling the same peacoats and tailoring, following the Times Square cruise show. Brand-driven, not public opinion.
